universe.target: one US-listed SPY ETF, US equity broad-index exposure, USD; not SP500 historical constituents or China/sector/overseas multiple evidence
universe.selection: original E US broad-index context and already frozen SPY cache, selected before new target generation
universe.input_source: AAII weekly survey plus same pre-existing SPY adjusted Close cache; no new market download
universe.membership: single ETF fixed identity, dynamic constituent qualification not required for isolated ETF risk target; still required for original E breadth
universe.listing_warmup: keep all quote positions from1993 including invalid/missing; need200/252-window warmup and1995-start
universe.actions_dividends: cache historical adjustment vintage unknown, no new reconstruction
universe.calendar: actual SPY quote dates; weekends not counted; no missing-close date compression; external exchange holiday calendar not independently qualified
universe.weight: one eligible survey date one equal observation; no ETF cross-section
universe.history_seen: entire historical cache previously observed; no independent untouched data

objects.x: candidate:sentiment.aaii-spread@draft-1 = 100*(bullish-bearish) survey percentage points; original candidate formula unchanged
objects.estimator: local:sentiment.bounded-risk-mean@1.0.0; protocol-local method, not globally registered production object

publication_time.assumed: source date+7calendar days at23:59 Asia/Shanghai, first SPY quote date strictly after assumed date is t; features use its close; target begins next quote close
publication_time.actual_first_publication: unknown; added delay is scenario assumption, does not prove historical availability
publication_time.historical_revisions: unknown; one survey row, no forward-fill
publication_time.duplicate_t: sort source_date then physicalsource_row; keep latest source for same t

target.window: quote indexes a=t_index+1 through b=t_index+121 inclusive; exactly121closes120return segments
target.meaning: largest peak-to-later-trough decline inside fixed future window; peak cannot precede window; not initial-close return, account drawdown, or probability of crossing a loss threshold
target.valid: all121closes finite positive, both ends<=2026-06-30; actualy0<=y<100 unmodified
target.maturity: train only t and target_end strictly before Jan1 of fitted evaluationyear; complete endpoint required
target.missing: exclude entire invalid/incomplete path, never shorten or fill; retain exclusion record

estimation.schedule: annual expanding fits2010..2026; if evaluationyear has no eligible row no fit; each model only identical full-eligible common training dates, mintrain100
estimation.I: arithmetic mature training-risk mean, same dates; counted as one fit per year for budget
estimation.feature_scaling: training only means and population std ddof0; finite scales>0 required, no coefficient sign flip or feature selection
estimation.objective: mean((expit(intercept+Z@slopes)-y_pp/100)^2)+0.001*sum(slopes^2); mean not sum, intercept unpenalized, target not clipped/floored
estimation.lambda_rationale: one fixed research method parameter before new risk target/performance; shrink extreme standardized slopes and avoid physically negative risk, no optimality or investment meaningful-size claim
estimation.optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize method L-BFGS-B, analytic gradient; single start intercept logit(mean trainrisk/100), slopes0; no bounds/restarts/search
estimation.constant_zero_train_target: if mean trainrisk0, all nonnegative trainrisks0: analytic constant0 branch, interceptnull recorded, no target modification
estimation.convergence: stop if optimizer not success, any result nonfinite, or maxabs finalgradient>1e-6; retain every startedfit and failure; one objective code correction may be authorized within residual budget, no solver/hyperparameter tuning
estimation.local_minimum_limit: nonlinear objective may have local optima; successful single-start optimization is not global-optimum proof

coverage: require finite x and all fivebackgrounds+y for ALL four models, one common eligible date set; raw survey and quote rows to exclusions, maturetrain and eval counts all reported
primary_comparison: 100*(1-MSE(BX)/MSE(B)), same target/dates/estimator/preprocessing/year schedule; positive=less squared estimation error, not money return
performance: RMSE percentage points: larger mistakes count more
prediction mean and actual mean, signed mean error

uncertainty.method: paired noncircular moving contiguous blocks of survey dates; jointly resample all models same indices, nrows retained by truncation; existing predictions not refit
uncertainty.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentile of squared-error-improvement values; store all draws
uncertainty.limits: overlapping120day outcomes, long regime persistence, old family selection and annual model fitting are not fully represented; no formal whole-family significance claim

stability.delete_one_year: saved predictions only, no refitting or selecting alternate model
stability.contribution: eachyear and fixedbands totalpaired squared-error reduction; sumpositive/sumnegative separately; largestyear and remove effects reported
stability.overlap: adjacent actual shared future-return segments with target indexes, count/% and min/median/max

minimum_attention_size.status: not investment-qualified; exploratory effect magnitude only
minimum_attention_size.reason: no specified account action/fees/capital impact to set justified financial threshold; no small-effect equivalence/no-meaningful-value claim

selection_history: new single risk target and one method selected after prior forecasts and Pro suggestedriskbranch; all prices previously seen. This is exploration, not independent validation.
